packageRules.description: Angular 22 peers typescript >=6.0 <6.1. TypeScript 7 is the native port and no Angular release accepts it yet.
@angular/build 22 peers vitest ^4. Taking vitest 5 leaves npm unable to resolve the tree at all, so every later lockfile update fails.
@apollo/server and @apollo/subgraph peer graphql ^16. Taking graphql 17 breaks every subgraph build until Apollo ships support.

minor and patch land as one reviewed-by-CI batch. github-exporter reads the automerge label to tell an update it could merge on its own from one that always needed a person, so renaming the label blanks that half of the SDLC dashboard. recreateWhen is always because two batches a day apart can share a title like 'update non-breaking to v22.2.1', and Renovate turns automerge off when it finds a merged PR with the same title.
Debian and Alpine security fixes arrive as a rebuild of the same base tag. A digest pin makes each rebuild a PR, which rebuilds and redeploys the app image.
A pin locks the digest the tag serves today. Any pod pulling that tag gets the same image, so waiting adds nothing.
A major reaches a human on its own
